name: Auth screen shell

geometry.shell: min-height 100vh; overflow-x hidden; flex column; min-width 300px; background auth.surface.shell
geometry.panel: NONE — there is no card, panel, border or shadow. Content sits flat on the shell background.

responsive.all: identical layout at 1440 / 1024 / 390 apart from the content column width (508px -> 326px). No type scale change at all.

notes: Line-height 1.55, not the marketing 1.5. Spacing scale 4/8/16/32/48. Radii 12/16/24.
No Mantine breakpoint fires on this screen; the only responsive change is the content column narrowing, which falls out of max-width + padding alone.
At 390 the 400px-wide illustration overflows the 326px column to x = -5 and is clipped by overflow-x:hidden. That is the original's behaviour, reproduced on purpose.
